subject: general
question:
which of the following is/are correct related to Adrenalin hormone?

(i) Heart beats faster

(ii) Breathing rate increases

(iii) Decreases blood pressure
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Adrenaline, also known as epinephrine, is a hormone released by the adrenal glands in response to stress or excitement.
 
• It prepares the body for 'fight-or-flight' response, causing several physiological changes.
 
• **Heart beats faster:** Adrenaline increases the heart rate to pump more blood to muscles and vital organs.
 
• **Breathing rate increases:** It also increases the respiratory rate to supply more oxygen to the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blood Pressure:** Adrenaline typically increases blood pressure by causing the blood vessels to constrict, not decrease it.
 
• **Sympathetic Nervous System:** Adrenaline is part of the body's sympathetic nervous system, which is responsible for the 'fight-or-flight' response.
 
• **Glucose Levels:** It also increases glucose levels in the blood by stimulating glucose release from the liver.
 
• **Adrenal Glands:** These glands are located on top of the kidneys and are responsible for the production of several important hormones including adrenaline.
 
• **Medical Use:** Adrenaline is used medically in emergencies like cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, and severe asthma attacks.
